C1484.title: Harmony Horizon Bridge Hack
C1484.summary: In June 2022, Harmony's Horizon cross-chain bridge was attacked and approximately $100 million in virtual assets was stolen. The FBI later attributed the theft to the North Korean cyber group Lazarus Group, also known as APT38, and traced part of the proceeds through privacy protocols. Harmony subsequently proposed compensating users by increasing the supply of ONE tokens.
